data.description: This mask transforms the wearer's face into a stone statue and its voice into an emotionless monotone. Though it allows the wearer to speak, its facial expressions and voice betray little emotion. At 4th level, a quinggong monk (Ultimate Magic) may select this spell as a ki power costing 1 ki point to activate
data.name: Mask of Stony Demeanor
